questions.q: What did Abraham make his servant swear about a wife for Isaac?
choices: To find the richest woman in Canaan
To bring a wife from Egypt
Not to take one of the daughters of the Canaanites, but from Abraham's kindred
To let Isaac choose for himself
questions.explain: Take a wife of the seed of thy fathers (Tobit 4:12); the custom was kept from the beginning, before Moses.

questions.q: What sign did the servant ask for at the well?
choices: The damsel who offers to draw for his camels also
questions.explain: Before he had done speaking, Rebekah came out: very fair, a virgin, and kind.

questions.q: What did Rebekah do when she saw Isaac?
choices: She took a vail and covered herself
questions.explain: The four mothers covered their heads as a sign of submission; that is the custom 1 Corinthians 11 goes into.

questions.q: Why must the chosen not marry into the other nations, according to the law?
choices: They will turn away thy son from following the Most High to serve other gods
questions.explain: Solomon is the prime example: he loved women of the other nations and went into their gods (Deuteronomy 7:3-4).
